build_transform_for_training: build a torchvision transform pipeline with random crop, flip, and normalization for training data
build_transform_for_testing: build a torchvision transform pipeline with resize, center crop, and normalization for test data
build_dataset_cifar10: build a CIFAR-10 dataset with automatic download and the specified transform for training or testing
build_dataset_cifar100: build a CIFAR-100 dataset with automatic download and the specified transform for training or testing
build_dataset_flowers_or_pets: build an Oxford Flowers or Pets dataset with the specified transform for transfer learning
